description: This file contains shell functions related to configuring and managing 'xfrm' protocol interfaces, including setup, teardown, and initial configuration functions for the network protocol.

methods.name: proto_xfrm_setup
methods.description: Configures the xfrm protocol on a specified interface, setting parameters such as mode, mtu, zone, multicast, and tunnel link dependencies.

methods.name: proto_xfrm_teardown
methods.description: Tears down or cleans up the xfrm protocol configuration for a specified interface.

methods.name: proto_xfrm_init_config
methods.description: Initializes the default configuration parameters for xfrm, such as mtu, tunlink, zone, ifid, and multicast.
